summary: WAYLOAM v0.2.5.alpha cleans up the everyday UI: a visible expressive daily-target slider, truly full-screen Settings, and much less explanatory copy across the app.
highlights: Daily target now uses a thick segmented Material slider with a vertical thumb, clear gap, and WAYLOAM secondary colors.
Settings is now a true full-screen destination with no empty navigation bar or white strip at the bottom.
Planner, Ride, Gear, Safety and Settings have been trimmed to concise rider-facing copy.
added: A custom Material 3 daily-distance slider using the secondary and secondary-container palette roles.
changed: Settings renders independently from the main five-destination navigation shell.
Appearance, update and About labels are shorter and more direct.
Gear uses simpler Loadout, Packed, Bags and Inventory language.
Ride removes implementation-roadmap text and keeps only navigation context.
Safety keeps emergency actions, location and contact controls without implementation commentary.
fixed: Fixed the low-contrast daily-target slider that was difficult to see.
Fixed the white bottom strip shown while Settings was open.
Removed redundant No AI, native-action and prototype explanatory text from the rider interface.
